question: Once the patient recovers from his acute illness, Candida antigen injection into his skin reveals no signs of inflammation after 48 hours. The same test performed in his mother produces 12 mm of skin induration within 48 hours. Which of the following cells are directly involved in the effector response observed in the mother?

options.text: B lymphocytes and CD4 T lymphocytes
B lymphocytes and CD8 T lymphocytes
